- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

description.en:
The UUID of the server. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas query-attack-count --from sas --lang zh --source-ip 175.0.XX.XX --uuids 1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas QueryAttackCount --region cn-hangzhou --SourceIp '175.0.XX.XX' --Lang zh --From sas --Uuids '1587bedb-fdb4-48c4-9330-000000000000'
